substantive_source_checks.reasoning: ComposeShiftCloseSlipAsync loads the closed shift; ComputeBreakdownAsync re-reads current order/refund/movement/expense rows, then expected/actual/difference prefer the values saved on Shift. Thus the headline close figures are frozen where present, but explanatory components can be reconstructed later from mutable rows. Expense breakdown separately groups paid-from-drawer expenses by category. The query has no mutation. LoadCloseWarningsAsync counts pending electronic and unpaid orders filtered by shift, but selects all Status==Open DriverCustodies without joining delivery ShiftId, and totals ExpectedPiastres globally.

Pure ticket composition. Close ticket prints breakdown components, expected/actual/difference, grouped expense lines, note and warnings; no posting. Expense ticket doc comment explicitly says printing posts nothing. Difference label maps sign, does not recompute arithmetic.

Close/preview calculation filters orders, drawer-paid expenses and posted treasury movements by ShiftId; refunds are itemized but not subtracted twice. Reprint invokes this same current-data calculation, so post-close immutability or revision policy is the unresolved condition behind recomputed components.

Handler locks and closes one shift row, computes expected via ShiftReconciliation, takes actual count, and comments that driver custody does not block shift close; it is surfaced on dashboard and handover slip. This supports warning-only effect and gives no assurance the query scope should be global.

Named shift-scoped rule selects deliveries by ShiftId and custodies via DeliveryId. Contradicts an unqualified interpretation that the close slip is expected to show only that shift, while the handler/comment describes unsettled custody more generally.
Existing test verifies same-shift custody inclusion and explicitly excludes another shift in the domain helper, not in print query.
Integration test closes shift with same-shift unsettled custody, verifies it stays Open and warning is on slip; it does not set up a second shift to test leakage.
Persists idempotent PrintJob records and an audit event for reprint; it does not post sales, expenses, shifts, inventory or treasury.

Validates existing ShiftOpen/closed ShiftClose/Expense document, creates print job, appends audit event and saves; no business ledger mutation.
